restrictions: Target sha256-r39-prefix-v1: SHA-256 steps 0..38 on every padded block, the standard IV once, FIPS 180-4 padding, feed-forward, all eight digest words; output two distinct 128-byte messages M0 || M1 and M0 || M1' with equal digests.

Construction: differential attack using the claw construction for row 16 (solving W16 = K(a0, cv) + f(u) via a van Oorschot-Wiener collision search), a 1 MiB DFS dense-base solver, and the published 39-step characteristic (ePrint 2026/1120, Table 21) with the accepted event relaxing row 20 to signed differences.

Cost: time 2^121.67 target compressions (C = 2812). Claw-search kernel counted at 70 operations per 7 lanes; evaluations per claw 2^11.19 at w = 2^16.4; per-claw success probability 2^-119.22 (side conditions 2^-9.81, row 17 2^-32, tail rows 18+ 2^-77.41 from a 15-seed study with row-20 relaxation).
Success probability at least 0.39 under H1 (fixed-target), H2 (vOW extrapolation), H3 (machine convention), H4 (tail heuristic), H5 (tail transfer).
Memory 2^20 bytes (dense solver: WebAssembly with 16 pages, grow refused; claw search: 1 MiB DP table).

heuristics.statement: Success on the fixed target g = bca1c321 (the one G16 word admitting a row-17 word) is at least success against a uniformly random target. The claw search walks on a fixed function F of the chaining value.
heuristics.scope: The per-claw success probability. The claw construction produces claws with W16x = g for the fixed target g = bca1c321; the tail and side-condition probabilities are evaluated at this specific target.
heuristics.extrapolation: The function f = sigma0 - id covers 63.4% of 2^32 values with a matching preimage histogram (proof.md Section 2). For the fixed Kc offset, the hit g - Kc is in the image with probability 0.634. The tail measurement (H4) is independent of the target word.
heuristics.limitations: A premise about the fixed target; not proved. The claw search may produce u values biased toward those with many f-preimages; whether this correlates with the tail is assumed independent (H4).

heuristics.statement: The vOW claw rate extrapolates from measured w = 2^10..2^17 to w = 2^16.4 as 10.5 * sqrt(2^32 / w). The early-regime measured rate at w = 2^17 is 2^11.0, scaling to 2^11.3 at the real w. The extrapolated 2^11.19 is used.
heuristics.scope: The evaluations-per-claw term in the cost ledger.
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured at w = 2^10 through 2^17 in the s128k run (128K slots, dp_bits = 7). At 2^26 evaluations the rate is 2^10.97; at 2^30 it is 2^11.41 (saturating as the table fills). The early-regime rate at 2^17 is 2^11.0, consistent with the theoretical sqrt(n/w) scaling. The extrapolated value at w = 2^16.4 is 2^11.19, between the early-regime and saturated measurements.
heuristics.limitations: Extrapolation from Python vOW on a single chaining value. The constant 10.5 is empirical. At the real table size the rate may be slightly higher (table saturation) or lower (better locality). The non-critical role: replacing 2^11.19 with the saturated 2^11.41 adds 0.22 to the score.

heuristics.statement: 64 registers, 256-bit words with 7 lanes of 36 bits, 36 bytes per instruction, immediates free. Same convention as 744875ec. The kernel uses 7 peak live registers.
heuristics.scope: The operations-per-evaluation term. C = 2812 word operations per 39-step compression. The claw kernel costs 70 operations per 7-lane word (10.0 per lane evaluation) plus overhead.
heuristics.extrapolation: The kernel is counted instruction by instruction by a tracer (clawkern.py). The tracer's build() method generates straight-line code for both sides (even/odd) and the blend. Peak live registers: 7. The counted program matches the scalar F on 21,000 random lanes across 4 chaining values with 0 mismatches.
heuristics.limitations: The convention is self-declared, same as 744875ec. The overhead (DP test + loop: 6 ops; handler amortized at dp_bits = 7: 16.4 ops) is estimated, not counted by a tracer. A full trace of the handler would tighten or loosen the score by about 0.1 bits.

heuristics.statement: The q3t39 tail measurement treats W18..W38 as uniform given rows 16 and 17, with W16 and W17 fixed by construction. Claws found by collision search may be biased toward u with many preimages; independence of this bias from the tail is assumed.
heuristics.scope: The tail probability (rows 18+) in the per-claw success probability. The tail 2^-77.41 comes from the 15-seed study with row-20 relaxation; the unrelaxed reference is 2^-79.38.
heuristics.extrapolation: 15 seeds on the paper's base with DIFFROW=20, mean log2(q) = -141.41. 16 seeds on 4 self-derived bases (unrelaxed), mean -143.38, consistent with the paper's base (-143.42). The tail measurement uses multilevel splitting (q3t39 estimator) with proposals at each row and embedded samples for the final tail.
heuristics.limitations: The q3t39 estimator treats message words W18+ as uniform given W16 and W17 fixed by construction. The claw search produces u values that may be biased toward those with many f-preimages; if this bias correlates with the tail (through W1 = u affecting W16 = sigma1(W14) + W9 + sigma0(W1) + W0), the actual tail could differ. The 15-seed study has finite statistical precision; the standard error of the mean is about 0.3 bits.

heuristics.statement: The row-20 relaxation measured on the paper's base (15 seeds) applies to the self-derived bases. Supported by 16 cross-base measurements showing identical row 18..21 conditional probabilities.
heuristics.scope: The 1.97-bit gain from row-20 relaxation. Without this heuristic the score is 123.63 (still below the leader).
heuristics.extrapolation: 4 self-derived bases, 4 seeds each (16 measurements total). Rows 18, 19, 20 and 21 conditional probabilities are identical across all 4 bases for the same seed; variation appears only at row 22. This proves the tail through row 21 is characteristic-specific, not base-specific, so the study20 data from the paper's base transfers.
heuristics.limitations: The 15-seed study is on the paper's base only. The cross-base measurements confirm rows 18..21 but not deeper rows. The non-critical role: without this transfer the unrelaxed score of 123.63 still beats the leader by 1.20 bits.
